show.name_meaning: Hebrew idiom for 'being smart' and a direct translation of the brand MAKE SENSE

canvas.format: JPG or PNG, RGB, under 512KB for Apple if required

usage.background: paper_white, the classic MAKE SENSE look of blue on white
usage.accent_only: amber_accent: badge pill, roof outline, underline swoosh, host name. Never more than ~8% of the image

display.style: ultra-condensed, heavy, poster-like Hebrew sans; the same style as the MAKE SENSE client documents
display.use: show name, episode titles, host name
display.size_rule: title fills ~45% of canvas width and is readable at 150px thumbnail size

body.use: badge pill, topics line, host role line

typography.logo: MAKE SENSE wordmark and two-seagull mark, used as an image, never retyped

layout.grid_reference: 1000x1000 units; multiply by 3 for the 3000px export

left_half.house_frame: solid brand_blue house silhouette (pentagon roof + walls) anchored to bottom-left, about 54% wide and 70% tall; an amber outline of the same house is offset ~22 units up-left; a darker blue band follows the roof slope
left_half.host: waist-up cut-out of the host, arms crossed, slight smile, facing toward the title (right side), standing in front of the house, head breaking above the roof line, soft blue drop shadow, cropped by the bottom and left edges

right_half.badge: amber pill top-right with a black microphone icon and black text
right_half.title: right-aligned stacked title. Show cover: 'עושים' black / 'שכל' blue, very large. Episode cover: 2 to 4 short lines, the punchline line(s) in blue
right_half.seagulls: the two blue seagulls from the logo flying in the gap between the host's head and the title
right_half.underline: one hand-drawn amber swoosh under the title
right_half.subline: short Heebo line under the swoosh

layout.bottom_band: brand_blue band along the bottom right (~62% wide, 15% tall) with a slanted left edge; text: 'עם' white + 'שיראל פרגר' amber in Karantina, role line below in white Heebo
layout.background_texture: very faint light-blue architectural blueprint grid, fading out from the upper right

variables.TITLE_LINES: 2-4 lines, max ~12 characters each, total under 6 words
variables.HIGHLIGHT_LINES: the line(s) printed in brand_blue, usually the question or the number

title_rules: Lead with a tension, number or question: 'כמה עולה טעות במשכנתא?'
Use real numbers only when they come from the episode
No more than 6 words on the image; details go in the episode description

avoid: stock money imagery: piles of cash, gold coins, piggy banks
small text that cannot be read in a phone thumbnail
changing the host's face, hair or beard
re-drawing or misspelling the MAKE SENSE logo
